title: Spikes at every chunk boundary in the streaming band-pass
scenario: After moving the impact detector from batch captures to the live stream in 1-second chunks, every pump alerts every second with kurtosis 12-15, including a freshly rebuilt one. The driver also logs clock drift.
task: Find why healthy pumps alert on every chunk, with sample-level evidence
Rule the clock drift in or out
Make the streaming filter chunk-size invariant and make reset() work
acceptance: Chunked output equals one-shot causal filtering within 1e-9 for three chunk sizes
Causal, no edge transients, healthy quiet, faulty alerts
ANSWER.md: root cause, red herring, why not zero-phase
